PM Modi highlights India's aviation progress and pilot achievements

Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke about India's aspirations in the aviation sector, referencing "Operation Sindoor" and mentioning Captain Smit Machhar. He stated that while the world currently recognizes Indian pilots, the future will see recognition for "Made-in-India" aircraft. This statement was made in the context of outlining major national goals.
